mutations.note: Backup removed: a differing existing hook is overwritten without being saved
Swapped source: the backup holds the new hook's content, so the old hook's content is lost
Flipped comparison: differing hooks are skipped as up to date, while identical hooks are backed up and reinstalled

mutations.original:
hook already up to date${NC}"
            return 0
mutations.note: Early return dropped: an identical hook falls through and gets a needless backup
Flipped existence guard: an existing hook is never compared or backed up before replacement
Inverted source guard: every hook that has a source file returns early, so nothing is installed
Dropped hook: post-commit is never installed
Wrong file name: no source exists for pre_push, so pre-push is not installed
